scripts.redis:setup: wsl -- bash -c "redis-server --port 6379 --daemonize yes --logfile /tmp/redis.log --bind 127.0.0.1 2>/dev/null; redis-cli config set protected-mode no"
scripts.dev: npm run redis:setup && concurrently --kill-others -n "AI,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,green,blue" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.electron:dev: npm run redis:setup && concurrently --kill-others -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ELECTRON" -c "green,blue,cyan" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
